text: Jonathan English, Founding Principal, Infrastory Insights, will address the TTC Board. This presentation will discuss steps that can be taken to improve speed and reliability of the streetcar network, as well as new LRT lines. Jonathan English has been invited to present to the TTC Board in accordance with Section 11 of the TTC By-law to Govern Board Proceedings
The Toronto Transit Commission received the Presentation: Developing a Surface Transit Revitalization Plan for information.
